about_the_game:
Once upon a time, in a faraway magical world, a cowardly warrior, a naive and gullible thief, an inept sorceress, and a wicked priestess (who couldn’t even heal a scratch) met each other. And thus, the legendary band of adventurers was born! Monsters and villains across the land will tremble at their sight — or maybe just burst into laughter (especially if the player fails to manage such an incompetent team). Can you turn these hopeless misfits into an unstoppable squad of daring heroines?

Behind its charmingly simple visuals, Heroines of Swords & Spells 2 is a vast, intricately crafted RPG designed to offer at least 50 hours of gameplay. This is not a game where you create your own story, face randomly generated dungeons, or grind endlessly to level up. Instead, it’s a handcrafted adventure with a rich, detailed world, unique lore, and a story that unfolds with purpose.

In this epic tale, you’ll guide a band of misfit heroines — each as flawed as they are endearing — on a journey to:

1) Confront the most evil and powerful necromancer the world has ever known.

2) Unravel the mysteries of their past and answer the profound question: What does it truly mean to be a heroine?

But that’s just the beginning! Heroines of Swords & Spells 2 also offers:

3) Dozens of branching quests, including unique storylines for each heroine. Conduct magical research, preach to the masses, serve in the Warriors Guild, or even save poor forest boars from reckless adventurers!

4) Well thought-out lore. Immerse yourself in a world filled with complex relationships, racial tensions, religious conflicts, and a history rich with grudges and intrigue.

5) A vast, open world. Explore three sprawling cities, delve into every crypt and cave, and traverse a global map teeming with secrets.

6) Estate management. Take charge of a family estate, receive petitioners, invest in construction, strike profitable deals, and, of course, pay your taxes!

7) Varied enemies and fair progression. Face unique monsters and powerful bosses, earning experience through quests, exploration, and clever tactics rather than mindless grinding.

8) Legendary artifacts and rare equipment. Discover, craft, and customize gear to suit each heroine’s fighting style and adapt to any challenge.

9) Arena battles. Prove your team’s worth in thrilling duels against other adventurers and rise to the top!

A World of Words

With over 250,000 words of dialogue and lore, Heroines of Swords & Spells 2 is a text-rich experience. Every line is written with care by a very human (and slightly unhinged developer, who hopes you’ll fall in love with the world and its quirky inhabitants.

short_description: A game for players who adore humorous fantasy adventures. A sprawling turn-based JRPG offering 50 hours of meticulously crafted plot, engaging quests, and no unnecessary grind. Four gorgeous yet utterly misguided heroines set out on perilous yet wildly entertaining adventures.
